slides.texte_overlay:
the 5 minute rules that
make life feel lighter

the two minute tidy

if a small mess takes less than two minutes to clear, clear it now. a tidy space makes a calmer head, and you stop feeling behind on absolutely everything.

the five minute walk

when you feel stuck or anxious, walk for five minutes before you decide anything. moving changes your mood faster than any amount of overthinking ever will.

the one line diary

before bed, write one sentence about your day and nothing more. a tiny habit you never skip beats a big, ambitious journal you abandon after just a week.

the five minute lesson

spend five minutes a day learning something just for fun, like a strange animal or a lost empire. small daily joys like this make ordinary days feel lighter.
slides.texte_sophia:
the five minute lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something just for fun, like a lost empire. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and it makes ordinary days feel lighter.

slides.texte_overlay:
the quick reply rule

if a message takes less than five minutes to answer, answer it now. unanswered messages weigh on your mind far more than the few minutes they would take.
